title: Upgrade provider-proxmox-bpg past async-callback status-write conflict bug, then unpause EnvironmentVMs
notes: Paused via crossplane.io/paused annotations in k8s/charts/crossplane-proxmox/templates/{workstation,windows,talos-pc01}.yaml (commit 4df62139) to stop a ~1.5 RV-bumps/s status-write conflict storm (upjet async-callback vs reconcile self-conflict on EnvironmentVM workstation/windows/talos-pc01) that kept kube-apiserver at ~3 cores and macintel01 at 100% CPU. Provider pkg: xpkg.upbound.io/valkiriaaquaticamendi/provider-proxmox-bpg:v1.15.0. Unpause = revert the three annotation blocks.

comments.author: yuri
comments.text:
BLOCKED (2026-10-15) — upstream fix required; both paths exhausted:

1) UPGRADE: latest provider-proxmox-bpg v1.21.0 still builds on upjet v2.2.0 — same async-callback self-conflict; no knobs changed. Not a fix vehicle.

2) UNPAUSE REPRODUCED (talos-pc01 MR): ~3800 MR writes in ~5.5 min (~590 RV bumps/min ≈ 10 RV bumps/s; 6× the incident's per-VM rate), then frozen at rv=156102356 after auto-brake re-applied crossplane.io/paused (Synced reason=ReconcilePaused). cb/min=0 throughout — conflicts are silent writes, no callback-failed log lines. VM Ready=True, provider-proxmox-bpg 1/1, provider healthy. Unpause without fix = guaranteed CPU storm recurrence (incident: kube-apiserver ~3 cores, macintel01 100% CPU).

CONCLUSION: keep all three EnvironmentVM MRs paused (commit 4df62139 annotations). Unpause condition = upstream provider release with async-callback conflict fixed (or upjet bump). Unpause procedure: revert annotation blocks in k8s/charts/crossplane-proxmox/templates/{workstation,windows,talos-pc01}.yaml.

comments.author: yuri
comments.text: UPGRADED 2026-10-16: provider-proxmox-bpg v1.15.0 -> v1.21.0 (736d1f0f chain: d1bd45b1 values+templates, 736d1f0f ignoreDifferences for runtimeConfigRef defaulting). Result: new ProviderRevision provider-proxmox-bpg-4ce19882438b Active, pull+activation clean, controller 1/1 Running 0 restarts, 0 EnvironmentVM log lines. 60s watch: all 3 VM RVs frozen (156102356/155803895/155803896), apiserver drifting down (3148m->2733m). CONFIRMED: v1.21.0 does not change the hot-loop (upjet v2.2.0 identical) — VMs stay paused via 4df62139 annotations; unpause still gated on an upstream release past the async-callback status-write conflict.
